note: Attribute names, values and child elements harvested from Rockwell-authored FactoryTalk View ME displays: the Displays folder of every installed ME demo application as ftview_export wrote it. The replay feeds each pair through checkDraftObject and expects no finding, so the draft-time vocabulary check cannot refuse content the vendor software itself writes. Values are kept only where the schema declares an enumeration, a pattern or numeric bounds, and at most two distinct values per attribute.
